name: deskpet
description: Plugin-based desktop pet framework: transparent always-on-top window, custom skins and animations, text chat, plugin system.

scripts.selfcheck: npm run build && npm run setup:runtime && node tools/launch.mjs --selfcheck --data-dir=.runtime/selfcheck-userdata
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && npm run setup:runtime && node tools/selftest-live-ui.cjs
scripts.assets:maid: npm run build && node tools/pack-blue-maid.mjs && node tools/pack-blue-maid-actions.mjs && node tools/pack-blue-maid-expressions.mjs && node tools/attach-builtin-action-profiles.mjs
scripts.test:live2d: npm run build && npm run setup:runtime && node tools/selftest-live2d-ui.cjs
scripts.dist:beta: npm run template:actions && npm run setup:runtime && node tools/package-beta.mjs
scripts.dist:beta:dir: npm run template:actions && npm run setup:runtime && node tools/package-beta.mjs --dir
scripts.test:gameplay: npm run build && npm run setup:runtime && node tools/selftest-pet-play-ui.cjs
